query: select id, ext, has_thumbnail, count(*) over() as "total!" from files order by case when $3 = 'created_at' and $4 then created_at end asc, case when $3 = 'created_at' and not $4 then created_at end desc, case when $3 = 'size' and $4 then size end asc, case when $3 = 'size' and not $4 then size end desc, case when $3 = 'width' and $4 then width end asc, case when $3 = 'width' and not $4 then width end desc, case when $3 = 'height' and $4 then height end asc, case when $3 = 'height' and not $4 then height end desc, case when $3 = 'original_hash' and $4 then original_hash end asc, case when $3 = 'original_hash' and not $4 then original_hash end desc, id desc offset $1 limit $2
